name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: Configurable implement_test_command in test_gate.py: the IMPLEMENT deterministic correctness gate now resolves its test command from the implement_test_command key, read by a direct tolerant stdlib json.load of ${project_dir}/.auto-maintainer/config.json (the key is owned by safety-governance's schema; the gate is a contract-bound READER of that one key and does NOT import safety-governance, staying stdlib-only and byte-for-byte shippable). Three-way: null/absent runs <feature-dir>/test/run.py (historical behavior, incl. missing-run.py=failed); a shell command string runs that command (shell=True, cwd=feature dir, exit 0=pass); the sentinel 'none'/'skip' (case-insensitive) skips the gate with a passed=True no-op verdict (harness-less opt-out, verification defers to the GATE-state regression_command). Added --test-command (override) and --project-dir (config location) CLI args; resolution is tolerant (missing/unreadable config or absent key -> run.py default, never crashes). The implementer agent invocation and the {feature,passed,returncode,summary} verdict schema are UNCHANGED. spec.md + contract.md were authored/committed in 5f75f5e.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md + contract.md for configurable implement_test_command already authored and committed in 5f75f5e; this cycle implements test_gate.py against the already-committed spec
